tdm.text: Eshki Dragonclaw escapes into the mountains after her hunting group is attacked by one of Atarka's brood and meets Alniul, and later she is chosen as Dragonclaw by the whisperers after Surrak challenges her and she defeats him.

During the Stormnexus Ritual she calls the spirit dragon Ureni into being, and when Ureni cannot give guidance and says they have two weeks, she and Alniul travel toward Rainveil Forest, tending to the dead, where they find Surrak wounded by a glowing lake.

Eshki remembers how she wounded Surrak with ice and recognizes she cast aside the spirits too, so she welcomes everyone to the fire and brings Surrak into the song, ending the blight, and Surrak rejoins the clan.
Months later, Eshki, Alniul and Surrak share a meal and Surrak vows to take back his clan someday.
